correctness.rationale: The labelled crown adjacency is exactly [[0,J-I],[J-I,0]], and 2 is a unit in characteristic three. The conjugation gives B and -B; J^2=nJ fixes all spatial Jordan blocks. The lifted T blocks are J2(±1), J4(±1), or irreducible quadratic X^2+1, with the crucial Jordan4 justified by one-dimensional eigenkernel. The displayed E_n(t) formulas follow from block-power nullity; the three claimed sharp global orders have explicit full-size blocks. Möbius inversion is exact because T has a displayed inverse. An independent modular eliminator verified 216 exact nullities for n=5..10, and neighbor-based direct trajectories confirmed 360 period closures. Tests do not replace the infinite proof.
